page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CL processor. The instance provides 208 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, resulting in 208 vCPUs. It is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 14.77 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re6.52xlarge offers high memory density per vCPU, making it a specialized resource allocation for memory-bound workloads rather than general compute or storage-heavy tasks.

Given the massive memory capacity of over three terabytes and the dedicated 208-core Intel Xeon processor, this instance is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data caching layers, and real-time big data analytics workloads that require substantial RAM without local storage dependencies.
